name: 1-start.jpg
setup: Serve game/ (node serve.ts, port 8902) and open /?shot=start&seed=7 at 1280x720. The title screen poses itself over the bay at golden hour (clock 18:36, camera drifting over Isla Brisa). Wait ~1s for the first frame to settle, capture the full canvas.

name: 2-drive.jpg
setup: Open /?shot=drive&seed=7. The scene starts the player at the wheel of an Alder Sedan on a Centro avenue at 10:24 with scripted input holding W and weaving gently; traffic, a taxi and pedestrians are live. Capture after ~2.5-4s, mid-avenue with traffic around the car and the HUD/minimap visible.

name: 3-chase.jpg
setup: Open /?shot=chase&seed=7. The player flees west on the harbour avenues in a red Cargador Muscle at 18:12 with wanted heat preset to 3 stars; three Patrulla cruisers spawn in pursuit and more join via the normal police system (they shoot from 3 stars). Capture after ~3-5s with cruisers in frame, light bars flashing and stars lit on the HUD.

name: 4-docks.jpg
setup: Open /?shot=docks&seed=7. Morning (09:06) at the Almacén Pulpo yard in El Puerto: the player stands on foot with a pistol, three hostile crew are staged around the crates and a pickup, mission banner up. Scripted input aims at the nearest hostile and fires in bursts, so capture within the first ~1-3s to catch muzzle flash, tracers and hit particles.
